changelog: v10.15.0: Effect characters + smart file naming. One-tap production colours on any take — Underwater (deep low-pass + watery chorus + tape wobble), Telephone, Cassette, Vinyl, Dream, Megaphone, and Clean (dry reset) — plus each genre's own signature space (dub ping-pong delay, vapor chorus, psy roll), tempo-synced to the take. A stereo tone filter was added to the FX chain and is tweakable in the FX tool. Every session and exported MIDI/stem is auto-named Artist_Date_Key_BPM_Kammerton (e.g. Echoel_2026-06-12_Cm_124bpm_A440_Melody-4bar.mid) — a take lands in your DAW already labelled. Concert pitch (Kammerton) defaults to A440 and is user-changeable (432–444). On-device, private, free.

v10.14.0: Tools page reduced to the essentials (505 → 261 lines). Replaced the 12 marketing 'engines' with 5 focused sections grounded in deep research + a marketing analysis: (1) The Body Is the Instrument — sensors + bio→music, explained not mystified, not medical diagnosis; (2) Bio-Driven Sound & Loops — 12 genres, synthesis engines, two-decimal BPM/Kammerton, tempo-synced FX/LFO, loop cutting 2/4/8/16/32 bars; (3) Into Your Studio — Your Way — MIDI 2.0/MPE in&out, Ableton Link, audio out, WAV/MIDI stem export, AUv3 (AUM/Cubasis/Drambo/Loopy Pro/BeatMaker/GarageBand), OSC/ADM-OSC; (4) For Everyone, Everywhere — VoiceOver-first, Music Haptics, legibility, 3 Hz ceiling, private & free; (5) Roadmap (Planned) — visuals/video/streaming/lighting/AI honestly NOT in the app today. Positioning: the most accessible way to make music; biofeedback that plays, not just measures. On-device, no cloud, free.

v10.13.0: Honesty & positioning pass — the site now leads with the real USP: 'Your heartbeat makes music. Meditate or create.' Homepage hero, title, and meta rewritten around bio-generative composition (calm down / observe yourself, or lock to a BPM and export to Ableton, Logic, FL Studio). Overview lead + Video pillar corrected (video/RTMP tagged Planned, not shipping). FAQ video-NLE and RTMP overclaims rewritten to roadmap statements (OSC/ADM-OSC/Art-Net/sACN are the live outputs). Added a Safe Use warning to the Health page (no driving/machinery, no alcohol/drugs, coordinate medication with your provider). Cache + asset version bumped.

v10.12.2: Performance & stability — removed the nav backdrop-filter blur (was repainting on every scroll → judder) for a solid bar; eliminated the double page-reload flicker (service worker now updates silently in the background; the cache-guardian is the single, debounced refresh path); bumped SW cache. No more flicker/stutter on scroll.

v10.12.1: Universal Bluetooth heart-rate support — the BLE client now connects to ANY standard Heart Rate Service device (Polar, Wahoo, Garmin/CooSpo/Magene straps, watches in broadcast mode), not just Polar. Camera rPPG marked LIVE (locks on device). Honest Oura/smartwatch FAQ: Oura has no real-time third-party BLE — it arrives via Apple Health (delayed); for latency-free live use the camera or a BLE strap. Corrected the camera-pulse description to finger-on-rear-lens rPPG.

v10.12.0: New social share preview — renamed OG image to og-cover.png (forces WhatsApp/Facebook/iMessage to drop the old cached green 'Quantum' card and refetch the current grayscale-on-black CI). Cache version bumped so browsers reload.

v10.12.0: Immersive / ADM-OSC — Echoel now streams the body as an audio object (breath→azimuth, coherence→distance, HRV→elevation, motion→gain) over the open ADM-OSC standard into object-based renderers (Adamson FletcherMachine, L-ISA, d&b Soundscape). Documented on Architecture + Tools; opt-in from the Sync tab. No vendor SDK.

v10.12.0: Honesty fix — replaced the Vision Pro FAQ overclaim ('quantum light spaces', photon particles, eye-gaze, 8 immersive modes as if shipped) with the accurate immersive story (ADM-OSC object source today; dedicated Vision Pro app on the roadmap).
